     1	package example
     2
     3	import "fmt"
     4
     5	// QuantizeIndexed converts a full-color image to indexed color.
     6	func QuantizeIndexed(img image.Image, numColors int) *image.Paletted {
     7		bounds := img.Bounds()
     8		width, height := bounds.Dx(), bounds.Dy()
     9		colors := extractColors(img, numColors)
     10		palette := color.Palette(colors)
     11		indexed := image.NewPaletted(bounds, palette)
     12		for y := 0; y < height; y++ {
     13			for x := 0; x < width; x++ {
     14				indexed.Set(x, y, img.At(x, y))
     15			}
     16		}
     17		return indexed
     18	}
     19
     20	// Helper function
     21	func extractColors(img image.Image, n int) []color.Color {
     22		seen := make(map[color.Color]bool)
     23		var colors []color.Color
     24		bounds := img.Bounds()
     25		for y := bounds.Min.Y; y < bounds.Max.Y; y++ {
     26			for x := bounds.Min.X; x < bounds.Max.X; x++ {
     27				c := img.At(x, y)
     28				if !seen[c] {
     29					seen[c] = true
     30					colors = append(colors, c)
     31					if len(colors) >= n {
     32						return colors
     33					}
     34				}
     35			}
     36		}
     37		return colors
     38	}
     39
     40	// ConvertToGrayscale converts an image to grayscale.
     41	func ConvertToGrayscale(img image.Image) *image.Gray {
     42		bounds := img.Bounds()
     43		gray := image.NewGray(bounds)
     44		for y := bounds.Min.Y; y < bounds.Max.Y; y++ {
     45			for x := bounds.Min.X; x < bounds.Max.X; x++ {
     46				gray.Set(x, y, img.At(x, y))
     47			}
     48		}
     49		return gray
     50	}
